title: New aviation rules from 1 Jan 2027: clearer fare breakdowns
description: The Bharatiya Vayuyan Niyam, 2026 applies from 1 Jan 2027. Airlines must show fare breakdowns, and the Centre can step in on fares in extraordinary cases.
topic: New aviation rules from 1 January 2027 on airfare transparency

title: New MHA ID rules for Indians travelling to Nepal and Bhutan
description: An amended MHA order requires Indians to show approved ID for Nepal and Bhutan. Passport is needed for third-country trips via these borders. Check the details.
topic: New MHA passport and ID rules for Indians travelling to Nepal and Bhutan

title: Digi Yatra trial for international flights at Hyderabad airport
description: Hyderabad is among seven airports trialling Digi Yatra on international flights for Indian e-passport holders on select Air India and IndiGo flights.
topic: Digi Yatra trials for international flights at Hyderabad airport

title: MEA asks Indians in France and Italy to follow advisories
description: The MEA has asked Indians in France and Italy to follow embassy and local advisories amid protests. Here is what Hyderabad travellers should check.
topic: MEA advisory for Indians in France and Italy during protests

title: China visa: Hyderabad applicants now apply at Embassy in New Delhi
description: From 26 October 2026, China visa centres in India stopped new applications. Telangana and AP applicants now go to the Chinese Embassy in New Delhi.
topic: China visa applications from Telangana and AP now go to the Chinese Embassy in New Delhi
